server.name: io.github.chrischall/musicbrainz-mcp
server.description: MusicBrainz MCP — search/browse music metadata, cover art, and submit tags/ratings/collections

environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the User-Agent sent to MusicBrainz.
environmentVariables.name: MUSICBRAINZ_USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID (write tools only). Register at musicbrainz.org/account/applications.
environmentVariables.name: MUSICBRAINZ_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret (write tools only).
environmentVariables.name: MUSICBRAINZ_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: OAuth refresh token with tag/rating/collection scopes (enables the write tools).
environmentVariables.name: MUSICBRAINZ_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN
